Variants.Content: The iconic weapon of Celtiberian and Iberian warriors was the curved falcata, forged using advanced iron-smelting techniques where iron plates were buried in earth to oxidize impurities before folding. With its forward-weighted recurved blade, the falcata combined the crushing impact of an axe with the clean slicing power of a sword, easily cleaving through bronze helmets and wooden shields.
